name: FixedSignerGuildConsensus

methods.name: usePlugin
methods.desc:
Use a plugin the Guild's wallet granted to this consensus app, with no proposal, for a signer whose
own power meets the threshold: the one case in which a ballot could only record that signer's
approval.

The Guild opts a plugin in by granting it to this app's address, by proposal, with whatever limits
the grant carries (methods, cooldown, expiry, escrow allowances). The wallet enforces every one of
them here exactly as for any other named caller. Only the signer threshold is consulted, against
the membership as it stands now; a Guild's percentage settings govern proposals, not this route.

One inner group: the wallet opens its plugin window for this app, the listed calls run inside it,
and the wallet closes and verifies the window. Each entry of `calls` is the application arguments
of one call to `plugin`: the method selector, then the wallet's ID, then the rest of that method's
arguments.

The calls are sent by this app, so a plugin method that pays its caller pays this app. This app has
no other way to release ALGO, so whatever it gained during the use is forwarded to the Guild, whose
sweep moves it on to the treasury.

methods.name: configure
methods.desc: Configure the initial member set through the paired Guild while it is in draft.

methods.name: consensusActionMbr
methods.desc: Quote and validate an opaque consensus action; unsupported codes are rejected.

methods.name: applyConsensusAction
methods.desc:
Apply an approved Guild consensus action; direct accounts cannot call this route.
The threshold is already bounded by total member power, so the proposal ID is unused.

methods.name: bindGuild
methods.desc: Permanently bind this consensus instance to the Guild created beside it.

methods.name: hasVoted
methods.desc: Whether `voter` has a vote on the proposal (a further vote changes it).

desc:
Allowlisted signer consensus with equal or explicitly assigned member weights.

All membership, threshold, and weight-mode administration happens through opaque Guild
consensus actions (`uint8 code || payload`, see ./constants.ts). The Guild kernel never
learns what those codes mean; it only routes them here and selects proposal settings.

threshold.desc: approval power required for a proposal to pass

eligiblePower.desc: sum of all assigned signer weights

membershipLocked.desc: whether membership changes have been permanently disabled

weightMode.desc: equal or explicitly assigned signer weighting

membershipEpoch.desc: monotonic counter incremented by every membership change

maximumMemberWeight.desc: largest assigned weight; bounds the proposer power a Guild may require

guild.desc: Guild permanently paired with this consensus application

activeBallots.desc: number of proposals with an open ballot

activated.desc: whether the paired Guild has left draft; settings are re-validated on policy changes afterwards

memberWeights.desc: Compact reusable weight slots bound maximum-power recalculation to at most 2 KiB.

memberHistory.desc: Closed membership intervals authenticate votes in ballots opened before a change.

ballots.desc: ballot state keyed by Guild proposal ID

votes.desc: individual vote receipts keyed by proposal ID and voter
